reuse.why: Extends the existing month-fill predicate isMonthFillCategory used by every month-wide action and parses notes with the existing shared extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; only the load of the #fixed group set is invoked separately in getMonthFillCategories and copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The exclusion sits in the month-fill selection in budget/actions.ts next to the hidden/template rules it joins.

scope.why: Only the selection query, the predicate, its comment and a focused test change.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised; callers must remember to fetch and pass fixedGroupIds, which is a small leak of the selection's inputs to one caller.

one_place.where: isMonthFillCategory in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by getMonthFillCategories and copyPreviousMonth, i.e. by every month-wide action.
